note: Honest coverage frontier. status: present = a runnable step drives real code and passes (must name a test); pending = specified behavior whose implementation does not exist yet; retrospective_gap = shipped without a driving test (must be zero for governed behavior, INV-22). Nothing is built yet, so every scenario is pending — this is the DESIGN GATE for the credential-delivery refactor (owner-approved 2026-07-22, from audits TG-153/TG-154). Scenarios bind to real code as tasks T-022-* land.

scenarios.name: High-value secrets are delivered as SecretRefs, never as plaintext environment values
scenarios.test: core/credential/delivery_test.go: TestDeliveryResolvesFromSubstrate (a declared ref resolves THROUGH the substrate) + TestDeliveryValidateRedactsLiteralToken (an inline literal where a reference belongs is refused and never echoed) + TestDeliveryDisabledIsBehaviourPreserving; core/preflight/secretpolicy_test.go pins the boot gate that makes it enforceable

scenarios.name: An unresolvable credential refuses the operation with no plaintext fallback
scenarios.test: core/credential/delivery_test.go: TestDeliveryUnresolvableRefusesNoFallback + TestDeliveryEnabledRequiresInjectedResolver + TestDeliveryValidateFailClosed (every misconfigured direction refuses rather than degrading to a plaintext scheme)

scenarios.name: The master key never resides in the worker and seal/unseal calls the external key service
scenarios.test: core/seal/master_test.go: TestSealerTransitRoundTrip (the wrapped DEK IS the Transit ciphertext and the calls hit /v1/transit/encrypt|decrypt/<key>; a refused DEK fails closed) + TestNewTransitWrapperFailClosed; core/seal/fromenv_test.go: TestTransitWinsOverALocalMasterKeyWhenBothAreConfigured (killing mutation executed)

scenarios.name: The actuation SSH identity is resolved just-in-time and not persisted between actuations
A leased actuation credential expires after its bounded lifetime
The read-only triage plane cannot resolve an actuation credential
scenarios.note: TG-153 (2026-08-04). The SUBSTRATE half is enforced by OpenBao (policy tg-triage-ro DENIES tg/actuator + tg/proxmox; verified live: triage token 403 on tg/actuator, 200 on hostdiag). The PROCESS half is this oracle in cmd/worker: with the full actuation .env present, a triage-plane process resolves "" for every actuation reference, and the boot SSH preflight does not even enumerate the mutate key. Siblings: TestTriagePlaneRefusesAnyActuationRef (core/credential — a triage process handed an actuation ref refuses to BOOT) and TestActuationActivityIsScheduledOnTheActuationQueue (temporal/runner — the mutating activity is dispatched to tg.actuate, which only the actuation worker polls).

scenarios.name: A resolved secret value never reaches a log, export, or error output
scenarios.test: core/config/config_test.go: TestRedactedAndLoggableRefNeverEchoThePayload; core/credential/plane_split_test.go: TestPlaneSplitValidationNeverEchoesALiteralSecret; modules/credsource/vault/vault_test.go: TestResolveRefMalformedErrorsNeverEchoThePayload (killing check executed on this arm); modules/credsource/ansible/ansible_test.go: TestAnsibleResolveRefMalformedErrorsNeverEchoThePayload; modules/credsource/oidctoken/oidctoken_test.go: TestOIDCResolveRefMalformedErrorsNeverEchoThePayload
